best_idea: On a clip change, hold the old pose frozen and blend it out over a fixed 0.2 s, and place attachments as a bone pose plus a local offset, while stripping the clip's root motion so the game moves the character.
decision_why: Take the frozen-previous-pose transition, the root-motion strip and the name-based gear merge with indexes resolved at load; do not port the channel decoder or the matrix code, since the animation library already evaluates skeletal clips.
acceptance: In the browser, a hero going from idle to a strike holds the old pose for 0.2 s and blends in without a snap; stride matches the game's movement speed because clip root travel is removed; a sword attached to the hand bone stays in the grip on every frame.
